senses.definition: (intransitive) To yield or give way to another.
examples: They will not submit to the destruction of their rights.
We submit to their superior judgment.

translations.word: ទទួលចុះចាញ់

senses.definition: (transitive) To yield (something) to another, as when defeated.
(ambitransitive) To enter or put forward for approval, consideration, marking etc.
examples: I submit these plans for your approval.

quotes.text: We submit that a wooden spoon of our day would not be justified in calling Galileo and Napier blockheads because they never heard of the differential calculus.

senses.definition: (transitive) To subject; to put through a process.
examples: I was submitted to a binding pledge.

quotes.text: [Skins] must be submitted to several washings, treadings, and stretchings, before they acquire the necessary pliancy.

senses.definition: (transitive, mixed martial arts, professional wrestling) To win a fight against (an opponent) by submission.
